competencies.name: Unity
competencies.description: Cross-platform game engine for 2D and 3D game development

prerequisites.notes: C# is the primary scripting language for Unity

alternatives.notes: Unreal Engine is a comparable game engine with different strengths
Godot is an open-source alternative game engine

competencies.name: Unreal Engine
competencies.description: Advanced game engine known for high-fidelity 3D graphics and AAA game development

prerequisites.notes: C++ is used for Unreal Engine programming

alternatives.notes: Unity is a comparable game engine

competencies.name: Godot
competencies.description: Open-source game engine for 2D and 3D games with its own scripting language

competencies.name: GameMaker Studio
competencies.description: Game development platform focused on 2D games with drag-and-drop and scripting

competencies.name: CryEngine
competencies.description: Game engine known for advanced graphics and used in games like Crysis

prerequisites.notes: C++ is used for CryEngine development

competencies.name: RPG Maker
competencies.description: Game development software focused on creating role-playing games

competencies.name: Construct
competencies.description: Game engine for 2D games using visual scripting and event-based logic

competencies.name: Defold
competencies.description: Free game engine for cross-platform 2D games with Lua scripting

prerequisites.notes: Lua is the scripting language for Defold

competencies.name: Cocos2d
competencies.description: Open-source framework for building 2D games and graphical applications

prerequisites.notes: C++ is commonly used with Cocos2d-x

competencies.name: LibGDX
competencies.description: Java-based game development framework for cross-platform games

prerequisites.notes: Java is the primary language for LibGDX

competencies.name: Phaser
competencies.description: Fast, free, and fun HTML5 game framework for browser-based games

prerequisites.notes: JavaScript is used for Phaser game development

competencies.name: PlayCanvas
competencies.description: WebGL game engine for browser-based 3D games and interactive content

prerequisites.notes: JavaScript is the scripting language for PlayCanvas

competencies.name: OpenGL
competencies.description: Cross-platform graphics API for rendering 2D and 3D graphics

prerequisites.notes: Often used with C or C++

competencies.name: DirectX
competencies.description: Microsoft's collection of APIs for multimedia and game programming on Windows

prerequisites.notes: C++ is commonly used with DirectX

competencies.name: Vulkan
competencies.description: Modern low-level graphics API for high-performance 3D graphics

prerequisites.notes: C++ is the primary language for Vulkan development
Understanding OpenGL helps when learning Vulkan

competencies.name: GLSL
competencies.description: OpenGL Shading Language for writing shaders for graphics rendering

prerequisites.notes: GLSL is used within OpenGL

competencies.name: HLSL
competencies.description: High-Level Shading Language for DirectX shader programming

prerequisites.notes: HLSL is used with DirectX

competencies.name: Box2D
competencies.description: Open-source 2D physics engine for games

competencies.name: Bullet Physics
competencies.description: Real-time 3D physics simulation library for games and simulations

prerequisites.notes: C++ is used with Bullet Physics

competencies.name: PhysX
competencies.description: NVIDIA's physics engine for realistic physical simulation in games

competencies.name: FMOD
competencies.description: Audio engine and middleware for interactive audio in games

competencies.name: Wwise
competencies.description: Audio middleware for interactive media and video games

competencies.name: MonoGame
competencies.description: Open-source framework for creating cross-platform games in C#

prerequisites.notes: C# is the language for MonoGame

competencies.name: XNA
competencies.description: Microsoft's game development framework (discontinued but still used)

prerequisites.notes: C# is the language for XNA

alternatives.notes: MonoGame is the spiritual successor to XNA

competencies.name: SDL
competencies.description: Simple DirectMedia Layer - cross-platform library for multimedia and input

prerequisites.notes: C is the primary language for SDL

competencies.name: Raylib
competencies.description: Simple and easy-to-use library for game programming in C

prerequisites.notes: C is the primary language for Raylib

competencies.name: Love2D
competencies.description: Framework for making 2D games in Lua

prerequisites.notes: Lua is the scripting language for Love2D

competencies.name: Pico-8
competencies.description: Fantasy console for making, sharing and playing tiny games

prerequisites.notes: Pico-8 uses a Lua-like language

competencies.name: Game Design
competencies.description: The art of creating game rules, mechanics, and player experiences

competencies.name: Level Design
competencies.description: Creating game environments, layouts, and spatial experiences

prerequisites.notes: Understanding game design principles helps with level design

competencies.name: Game Mechanics Design
competencies.description: Designing the rules and systems that govern gameplay

prerequisites.notes: Core game design knowledge is beneficial

competencies.name: Game UI/UX Design
competencies.description: Designing user interfaces and experiences specific to games

competencies.name: Game Balancing
competencies.description: Tuning game difficulty, economy, and mechanics for optimal player experience

prerequisites.notes: Understanding game design is essential for balancing

competencies.name: Narrative Design
competencies.description: Crafting stories and interactive narratives for games

competencies.name: Quest Design
competencies.description: Creating missions, objectives, and player-driven narratives in games

prerequisites.notes: Narrative skills enhance quest design

competencies.name: Game Networking
competencies.description: Implementing multiplayer and networked gameplay systems

competencies.name: Game AI Programming
competencies.description: Programming artificial intelligence for non-player characters and game systems

prerequisites.notes: Algorithm knowledge helps with AI programming

competencies.name: Procedural Generation
competencies.description: Creating game content algorithmically rather than manually

prerequisites.notes: Algorithm knowledge is beneficial for procedural generation

competencies.name: Game Analytics
competencies.description: Analyzing player data and metrics to improve game design and engagement

competencies.name: Game Monetization Design
competencies.description: Designing revenue models and in-game economies for games

prerequisites.notes: Game design understanding is essential for ethical monetization

competencies.name: Game Testing
competencies.description: Quality assurance and testing methodologies for games

competencies.name: Shader Programming
competencies.description: Programming visual effects and rendering techniques using shaders

prerequisites.notes: GLSL or HLSL knowledge is beneficial

competencies.name: Unity Shader Graph
competencies.description: Visual shader creation tool in Unity for creating custom shaders without code

prerequisites.notes: Unity knowledge is required

competencies.name: Blueprint Visual Scripting
competencies.description: Unreal Engine's node-based visual scripting system for game logic

prerequisites.notes: Unreal Engine knowledge is required

competencies.name: GDScript
competencies.description: Godot's built-in scripting language for game development

prerequisites.notes: Used within Godot engine

competencies.name: Game Audio Design
competencies.description: Creating and implementing sound effects and music for games

competencies.name: 3D Modeling for Games
competencies.description: Creating 3D assets and characters optimized for game engines

competencies.name: Game Animation
competencies.description: Creating and implementing character and object animations for games

competencies.name: Pixel Art
competencies.description: Creating retro-style graphics using individual pixels for games

competencies.name: VFX for Games
competencies.description: Creating visual effects like particles, explosions, and magic for games
